rule: E1 Unused, extended by rule rather than by hand: #148 section 7's list, #148's exclusion log, the revealed #138 slot registers, the two revealed excluded registers, and every pull request named in the revealed candidate inventory - candidates and the later fixes and confirming reports their rows cite. Only a backticked reference counts in a Markdown list or table, because these files also cite this project's own tickets in prose; a register is about one repository and every number in it resolves there. A candidate on this list cannot be reused blind, and closing an issue or renaming a slot does not restore blindness.
